name: android_find_image
description: Finds a picture on the screen and returns its center for android_tap: for games and canvases, which have no UI tree. The template is an image file (templatePath, e.g. a sprite from the project) or a screen region saved earlier (templateName). To save one, pass saveAs with x, y, width, height (pixels) or xRatio, yRatio, widthRatio, heightRatio; it is kept in memory until the server stops. Sizes 0.5×–3× are tried when the template does not match at its own size; rotation is not.

templatePath.description: PNG or JPEG file on the computer.

threshold.description: Minimum score, 0–1 (default 0.8). The best candidate is reported either way.

scale.description: Template size on screen relative to the file, if known (skips the size search).

saveAs.description: Save a screen region as a template under this name.

xRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

yRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

widthRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

heightRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
